12	# Base-local triviality: relPicMk-equality localizes to on-the-nose equality
13	
14	Two Čech Picard classes `L, L'` on the relative curve `C ⊗ Spec B` with equal image in the
15	relative Picard group `relPic C (overSpec k B)` differ by a class pulled back from the base
16	along the second projection (`relPicMk_eq_relPicMk_iff`).  A base class is, through the
17	Čech–Picard dictionary of the affine scheme `Spec B` (`Scheme.CechPic.toPic`), an invertible
18	`B`-module; invertible modules are finite projective, hence free at the stalk of every prime
19	`q`, and freeness spreads from the stalk to a basic open `D(f) ∋ q`
20	(`Module.FinitePresentation.exists_free_localizedModule_powers`).  So the base discrepancy
21	dies after localizing at `f`, and the two classes agree on the nose after base change to
22	`Localization.Away f`.
23	
24	## Main declarations
25	
26	* `CommRing.Pic.exists_notMem_mapAlgebra_eq_one` — Zariski-local triviality of the Picard
27	  group of a commutative ring: near every prime some basic-open localization kills a given
28	  Picard class.
29	* `AlgebraicGeometry.exists_notMem_cechPicMap_specMap_eq_one` — the same statement for Čech
30	  Picard classes of `Spec B`, through `toPic` and its naturality (`toPic_map`).
31	* `AlgebraicGeometry.exists_notMem_cechPicMap_eq_of_relPicMk_eq` — **base-discrepancy
32	  localization**: `relPicMk`-equal Čech classes on the relative curve agree on the nose
33	  after base change to `Localization.Away f` for some `f ∉ q`, for every prime `q` of the
34	  test ring.

36	  consumer form for widened divisor families: `relPicMk`-equal `picClass`es become equal
37	  `picClass`es of the `mapAlgHom`-restricted families near every prime.
38	-/

123	  awayMulOfDvd (f p * f q) (f p) (f q) rfl
124	
125	/-- The right comparison into the canonical overlap carrier of the pair `(p, q)`. -/
126	noncomputable abbrev awayMulRight (p q : Fin m) :
127	    Localization.Away (f q) →ₐ[k] Localization.Away (f p * f q) :=
128	  awayMulOfDvd (f p * f q) (f q) (f p) (mul_comm _ _)
129	
130	end Pack

132	/-! ## Existence -/
133	
134	set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000 in
135	-- Eight `Algebra`/`IsScalarTower` fields are discharged in the body at the canonical
136	-- carriers, and each unifies the section-ring algebra towers of two away localizations
137	-- at once; the defeq checks exceed the default budget (as in
138	-- `divFamZar.exists_isGlueValue` and `DivRepClassifyZar.exists_isDivRepClassify`).
139	/-- **The away-span glue at canonical carriers**: locally certified divisor classes over
140	the canonical away localizations of a finite spanning family `f`, agreeing after base
141	change along the two comparison maps into each canonical overlap localization
142	`Localization.Away (f p * f q)`, glue to a class over `S` restricting to each of them.
143	
144	This is the S5b keystone `DivFamZar.exists_glue_of_away_compat` with its instance pack
145	discharged at the canonical carriers: the overlap carrier receives both away carriers by
146	the comparison maps, the `S`-towers are `awayMulOfDvd_algebraMap`, and the `k`-towers are
147	the `AlgHom` commutation of the same maps.  Hypothesis and conclusion are stated on the
148	explicit `mapAlgHom` face and moved onto the instance face by the face-change bridge
149	`mapAlgHom_eq_mapAlg`, so no caller needs the pack. -/
150	theorem exists_glue_of_awaySpan {m : ℕ} (f : Fin m → S)
151	    (hspan : Ideal.span (Set.range f) = ⊤)
152	    (F : ∀ p : Fin m, DivFamZar C (Localization.Away (f p)) π n)
153	    (hcompat : ∀ p q : Fin m,
154	      DivFamZar.mapAlgHom (awayMulLeft (k := k) f p q) (F p)
155	        = DivFamZar.mapAlgHom (awayMulRight (k := k) f p q) (F q)) :
156	    ∃ F₀ : DivFamZar C S π n, ∀ p : Fin m,
157	      DivFamZar.mapAlgHom (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k S (Localization.Away (f p))) F₀ = F p := by
158	  classical
159	  -- the overlap carrier receives both away carriers, by the two comparison maps
160	  letI algL : ∀ p q : Fin m, Algebra (Localization.Away (f p))
161	      (Localization.Away (f p * f q)) := fun p q =>
162	    (awayMulLeft (k := k) f p q).toRingHom.toAlgebra
163	  letI algR : ∀ p q : Fin m, Algebra (Localization.Away (f q))
164	      (Localization.Away (f p * f q)) := fun p q =>
165	    (awayMulRight (k := k) f p q).toRingHom.toAlgebra
166	  -- the `S`-towers: each comparison map is the localization lift
167	  haveI towSL : ∀ p q : Fin m, IsScalarTower S (Localization.Away (f p))
168	      (Localization.Away (f p * f q)) := fun p q =>
169	    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (RingHom.ext fun x => by
170	      rw [RingHom.comp_apply, RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra]
171	      exact (awayMulOfDvd_algebraMap (k := k) (f p * f q) (f p) (f q) rfl x).symm)
172	  haveI towSR : ∀ p q : Fin m, IsScalarTower S (Localization.Away (f q))
173	      (Localization.Away (f p * f q)) := fun p q =>
174	    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (RingHom.ext fun x => by
175	      rw [RingHom.comp_apply, RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra]
176	      exact (awayMulOfDvd_algebraMap (k := k) (f p * f q) (f q) (f p)
177	        (mul_comm _ _) x).symm)
178	  -- the `k`-towers: the comparison maps are maps of `k`-algebras
179	  haveI towkL : ∀ p q : Fin m, IsScalarTower k (Localization.Away (f p))
180	      (Localization.Away (f p * f q)) := fun p q =>
181	    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (RingHom.ext fun x => by
182	      rw [RingHom.comp_apply, RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra]
183	      exact ((awayMulLeft (k := k) f p q).commutes x).symm)
184	  haveI towkR : ∀ p q : Fin m, IsScalarTower k (Localization.Away (f q))
185	      (Localization.Away (f p * f q)) := fun p q =>
186	    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (RingHom.ext fun x => by
187	      rw [RingHom.comp_apply, RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra]
188	      exact ((awayMulRight (k := k) f p q).commutes x).symm)
189	  -- the keystone, with the hypothesis transported onto the instance face.  The
190	  -- compatibility proof is deferred with `?_` so that the carrier families are fixed
191	  -- before it elaborates (otherwise `mapAlg`'s instance arguments stay metavariables).
192	  have hkey : ∀ l l' : ULift.{u} (Fin m),
193	      DivFamZar.mapAlg (C := C) (π := π)
194	          (Localization.Away (f l.down * f l'.down)) n (F l.down)
195	        = DivFamZar.mapAlg (C := C) (π := π)
196	          (Localization.Away (f l.down * f l'.down)) n (F l'.down) := by
197	    intro l l'
198	    rw [← DivFamZar.mapAlgHom_eq_mapAlg (awayMulLeft (k := k) f l.down l'.down)
199	        (fun _ => rfl),
200	      ← DivFamZar.mapAlgHom_eq_mapAlg (awayMulRight (k := k) f l.down l'.down)
201	        (fun _ => rfl)]
202	    exact hcompat l.down l'.down
203	  -- the keystone indexes over `Type u`, so the cover is reindexed by `ULift (Fin m)`
204	  obtain ⟨F₀, hF₀⟩ := DivFamZar.exists_glue_of_away_compat
205	    (fun l : ULift.{u} (Fin m) => f l.down)
206	    (fun l : ULift.{u} (Fin m) => Localization.Away (f l.down))
207	    (fun l l' : ULift.{u} (Fin m) => Localization.Away (f l.down * f l'.down))
208	    (by
209	      rw [show (Set.range fun l : ULift.{u} (Fin m) => f l.down) = Set.range f from
210	        ULift.down_surjective.range_comp f]
211	      exact hspan)
212	    (fun l => F l.down) hkey
213	  refine ⟨F₀, fun p => ?_⟩
214	  have hF₀p := hF₀ (ULift.up p)
215	  rw [DivFamZar.mapAlgHom_eq_mapAlg (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k S (Localization.Away (f p)))
216	    (fun _ => rfl)]
217	  exact hF₀p
218	
219	/-! ## Separation -/
220	
221	/-- **Separation in the canonical-carrier spelling**: two locally certified classes over
222	`S` agreeing after base change to every `Localization.Away (f p)` of a finite spanning
223	family agree — `DivFamZar.eq_of_away_eq` at the canonical carriers, whose instance pack
224	is the ambient one, with the hypothesis read on the explicit `mapAlgHom` face. -/
225	theorem eq_of_awaySpan_eq {ι : Type} [Finite ι] (f : ι → S)
226	    (hspan : Ideal.span (Set.range f) = ⊤)
227	    {F G : DivFamZar C S π n}
228	    (h : ∀ p : ι,
229	      DivFamZar.mapAlgHom (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k S (Localization.Away (f p))) F
230	        = DivFamZar.mapAlgHom (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k S (Localization.Away (f p))) G) :
231	    F = G := by
232	  -- the keystone indexes over `Type u`, so the cover is reindexed by `ULift ι`
233	  refine DivFamZar.eq_of_away_eq (fun l : ULift.{u} ι => f l.down)
234	    (fun l : ULift.{u} ι => Localization.Away (f l.down))
235	    (by
236	      rw [show (Set.range fun l : ULift.{u} ι => f l.down) = Set.range f from
237	        ULift.down_surjective.range_comp f]
238	      exact hspan)
239	    (fun l => ?_)
240	  rw [← DivFamZar.mapAlgHom_eq_mapAlg
241	      (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k S (Localization.Away (f l.down))) (fun _ => rfl) F,
242	    ← DivFamZar.mapAlgHom_eq_mapAlg
243	      (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k S (Localization.Away (f l.down))) (fun _ => rfl) G]
244	  exact h l.down
245	
246	/-! ## The `∃!` form -/
247	
248	/-- **The away-span glue, uniquely**: the glued class of `exists_glue_of_awaySpan` is the
249	unique class over `S` restricting to the given family, by `eq_of_awaySpan_eq`.
250	
251	**Note what this `∃!` does and does not say.**  It pins the value against *one* cover `f` and
252	*one* family `F`: it says the glue is determined by that data, not that it is independent of

256	An earlier version of this docstring claimed the `∃!` made that argument unnecessary; it does
257	not, and a fresh-context review caught the overclaim. -/
258	theorem existsUnique_glue_of_awaySpan {m : ℕ} (f : Fin m → S)
259	    (hspan : Ideal.span (Set.range f) = ⊤)
260	    (F : ∀ p : Fin m, DivFamZar C (Localization.Away (f p)) π n)
261	    (hcompat : ∀ p q : Fin m,
262	      DivFamZar.mapAlgHom (awayMulLeft (k := k) f p q) (F p)
263	        = DivFamZar.mapAlgHom (awayMulRight (k := k) f p q) (F q)) :
264	    ∃! F₀ : DivFamZar C S π n, ∀ p : Fin m,
265	      DivFamZar.mapAlgHom (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k S (Localization.Away (f p))) F₀ = F p := by
266	  obtain ⟨F₀, hF₀⟩ := exists_glue_of_awaySpan f hspan F hcompat
267	  exact ⟨F₀, hF₀, fun F₁ hF₁ =>
268	    eq_of_awaySpan_eq f hspan (fun p => (hF₁ p).trans (hF₀ p).symm)⟩
269	
270	end DivFamZar
